title: snowpack v1: weather-driven 3D snow column with time scrub and shove test
description: Browser-only Three.js site. Open-Meteo hourly record for Thredbo Top Station -> pure snowpack layer model -> 3D column; single UI element is a time bar (first snowfall to now). Push on the column fails the weakest interface below the push and the slab slides. Deploy to GitHub Pages via Actions. Architecture: weather adapters -> record schema -> model step fn -> hourly snapshots -> mechanics -> scene -> interaction.
notes: Interaction spec (Rob, 2026-09-15): open on a white screen; four clicks each cut one wall of the column (shovel cuts), camera zooms in on the freed column. Then: (a) push the column from the side at a height -> weakest interface below the push fails, slab slides; (b) hover top -> shovel appears; click = quick light tap, click+hold winds the arm up (to ~90deg) and release slaps harder -> compression-test style load from the top. Single UI: time bar (first snowfall -> now / season end, never future) plus a tiny season picker top-left. Bare stage. No server: browser fetches Open-Meteo directly; data-in-git collector is a later optional slot.
